cover_letter:
Dear Jimber team,

I'm writing to apply for the Strategic B2B Marketer role. What draws me to Jimber is the positioning itself: cybersecurity made simple and affordable for everyday businesses. That's a message that has to be clear, credible and consistent across every channel, and shaping that kind of B2B messaging is the work I want to do.

My experience sits where SEO, content and web meet. At Episto I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, tracking results in Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console. That analytical loop, testing and refining based on performance data, is how I approach campaigns. At KXP I supported SharePoint-based digital workplace projects for enterprise clients including ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, and built client websites from structure to content and social integration. I also use AI tools daily to automate research, content and audits, and I've implemented structured data and llms.txt files so sites stay visible in AI-driven search.

I have a technical background (front-end development, applied computer science coursework) which means I can work closely with product and sales teams and translate between marketing goals and technical reality. I'm fluent in English, native in Turkish, and improving my Dutch.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can help Jimber build awareness and demand for its cybersecurity solutions.

Kind regards,

Baver Ok
